gloss: to poke one's nose into; to get involved in

definitions.gloss: to poke one's nose into; to meddle in; to get mixed up in
definitions.explanation: To involve oneself in something that is not one's business, or to get deeply involved in an activity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{首|くび}を{突|つ}っ{込|こ}むな。
examples.english: Don't stick your nose into other people's business.

examples.japanese: {面白|おもしろ}そうな⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧{首|くび}を{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む。
examples.english: He jumps straight into anything that sounds interesting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{首|くび}を{突|つ}っ{込|こ}んだら、⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧なことになった。
examples.english: I got involved in my friend's trouble without thinking, and it turned into a real mess.

notes:
USAGE:
Usually critical (meddling, butting in), especially in the negative command {首|くび}を{突|つ}っ{込|こ}むな. It can also be neutral for plunging into a hobby or activity: ⟦{色々|いろいろ}→色々：02352_iroiro⟧なこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{首|くび}を{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む (to dabble in all sorts of things).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{余計|よけい}→余計：04090_yokei⟧なこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{首|くび}を{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む: to meddle where one is not wanted
- ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{首|くび}を{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む: to get mixed up in other people's problems

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ / ⟦{口出|くちだ}しする→口出しする：25233_kuchidashisuru⟧: to butt in with comments; {首|くび}を{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む is getting involved, not just talking.
- ⟦{干渉|かんしょう}する→干渉する：21453_kanshousuru⟧: to interfere (formal).
